# Boki growth: evolution, mutations, bonds and gifts

_Generated from `content/rules/evolve.json`, `content/evolution_v2`, `content/mutations`, `scripts/core/care.gd`._

## Evolution lines

Each species evolves into the next at its own level, with an Ink used on it, or by trade; where a line branches, the leading affinity picks. A Boki never evolves into a species without a model: it waits and evolves once the art exists. Levels stop at 100.

## Evolution nodes

Every Boki has four paths (Fierce, Steadfast, Curious, Swift); some species have an extra node on one. Nodes are budget-neutral: they move points or trade one strength for another.

| Node | Path | Needs | Grants | Flavor | Species |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spore Drift | Curious | level 8 after Curious | auto: delivery.radius x1.2, delivery.duration x0.75 | Its spore cloud spreads wider and thins out faster. | Mycroll |
| Barbed Tail | Fierce | level 8 after Fierce | active: delivery.range x1.2, effects.4.duration x0.7 | Its hook reaches further but stuns for less. | Vespyx |
| Curious | Curious | level 4 | 1 point from kin_damage to owner_regen | Raised to explore: it hits softer and keeps you patched up. | all |
| Fierce | Fierce | level 4 | 1 point from kin_hp to kin_damage | Raised to fight hard: it trades a little toughness for bite. | all |
| Dense Plate | Steadfast | level 8 after Steadfast | auto: delivery.hp x1.25, delivery.duration x0.8 | Its guard plate soaks more but drops sooner. | Gravadillo |
| Wide Prism | Steadfast | level 8 after Steadfast | active: delivery.length x1.25, delivery.duration x0.8 | A wider crystal wall that fades sooner. | Prismander |
| Steadfast | Steadfast | level 4 | 1 point from kin_speed to kin_hp | Raised to look after you: slower, sturdier. | all |
| Swift | Swift | level 4 | 1 point from kin_hp to kin_speed | Raised on the move: lighter and quicker. | all |
| Long Throw | Swift | level 8 after Swift | active: delivery.range x1.2, delivery.speed x0.85 | It throws its moon mark further, but slower. | Lunowl |
| Overtone | Swift | level 8 after Swift | add_modifier | Its echo pulse rings through the first foe it hits. | Echolop |

## Mutations

Rare inborn traits, rolled for wild and newly hatched Boki (1 in N at base odds). At most one per group. A parent passes one on 35% of the time, 60% if both parents have it.

| Mutation | Odds | Group | Looks | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Giant | 1 in 150 | size | Half again as big as it should be. | hp x1.12, speed x0.93 |
| Tiny | 1 in 150 | size | Pocket-sized, and quick with it. | speed x1.1, hp x0.92 |
| Piebald | 1 in 100 | palette | A pale coat splashed with patches of its true colour. | dmg x1.04 |
| Melanistic | 1 in 140 | palette | Coal-dark all over, with gold eyes. | dmg x1.05, hp x0.97 |
| Albino | 1 in 200 | palette | Snow-white, with rose eyes. | cd x0.94, hp x0.96 |
| Glowing | 1 in 180 |  | Its markings shine in the dark. Its hunter sees a little further. | carrier sight +0.08 |
| Twin-tail | 1 in 220 |  | Born with two tails, and doubly restless. | speed x1.05, cd x0.97 |
| Crystal | 1 in 300 |  | Gem spikes grow along its back. Riding with you, they harden your armor. | speed x0.97; carrier armor +6 |
| Starmarked | 1 in 400 |  | Speckled with tiny stars. A lucky Boki: a little better at everything. | hp x1.03, dmg x1.03, speed x1.03, cd x0.97 |

## Bond ranks

Trust runs from 0 to 100.

| From trust | Rank | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Wary | Might refuse a risky throw. |
| 25 | Friendly | Follows you around the farm. |
| 50 | Close | Starts picking up words. Skills hit 5% harder. |
| 70 | Devoted | Rushes to revive you without a second thought. |
| 90 | Soulbound | Never refuses you. +10% health and damage. |

| From level | Stage |
|---|---|

## Inborn gifts (IVs)

Five stats from 0 to 31, fixed for life. A bred egg takes 3 from its parents; a Rare Egg has 3 at 26 or better.

| IV | Affects | Most it adds (at 31) |
|---|---|---|
| Health | health in a match | +10% |
| Power | damage in a match | +10% |
| Speed | running speed in a match | +5% |
| Work | how fast it does farm jobs | +10% |
| Bond | how fast it fills your bond meter | +10% |

## Trained stats

Trained at the Training post with a timing drill.

| Stat | Per point | Drill |
|---|---|---|
| Power | +0.4% damage a point | Dummy strikes |
| Guard | +0.5% health a point | Brace and hold |
| Speed | +0.25% speed a point | Hoop dash |
| Focus | Skill recharges 0.3% faster a point | Still pond |

## Natures

A Boki's nature comes from its two strongest traits.

| Traits | Nature |
|---|---|
| bravery + temper | Fiery |
| bravery + loyalty | Valiant |
| bravery + curiosity | Daring |
| loyalty + temper | Protective |
| curiosity + loyalty | Gentle |
| curiosity + temper | Mischievous |
